changes.name: SkyboundServer
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")

local old=workspace:FindFirstChild("Skybound")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local world=Instance.new("Folder")
world.Name="Skybound"
world.Parent=workspace

workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight=-150

Lighting.ClockTime=13.5
Lighting.Brightness=2.5
Lighting.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(150,175,210)
Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(180,205,255)

local atmosphere=Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere") or Instance.new("Atmosphere")
atmosphere.Density=.22
atmosphere.Offset=.1
atmosphere.Color=Color3.fromRGB(205,225,255)
atmosphere.Decay=Color3.fromRGB(100,145,210)
atmosphere.Glare=.2
atmosphere.Haze=1
atmosphere.Parent=Lighting

local function part(name,size,pos,color,material,parent)
 local p=Instance.new("Part")
 p.Name=name
 p.Size=size
 p.Position=pos
 p.Anchored=true
 p.Color=color
 p.Material=material
 p.TopSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
 p.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
 p.Parent=parent or world
 return p
end

local function island(name,pos,radius)
 local model=Instance.new("Model")
 model.Name=name
 model.Parent=world

 local rock=part("FloatingRock",Vector3.new(radius*1.7,8,radius*1.7),pos-Vector3.new(0,5,0),Color3.fromRGB(92,82,78),Enum.Material.Slate,model)
 rock.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball

 local underside=part("Underside",Vector3.new(radius*1.15,12,radius*1.15),pos-Vector3.new(0,11,0),Color3.fromRGB(70,66,72),Enum.Material.Rock,model)
 underside.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball

 local grass=part("Grass",Vector3.new(radius*1.75,3,radius*1.75),pos,Color3.fromRGB(82,170,76),Enum.Material.Grass,model)
 grass.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
 grass.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,0,90)

 return model
end

local main=island("Grasslands",Vector3.new(0,65,0),52)

local spawn=Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
spawn.Name="SkySpawn"
spawn.Size=Vector3.new(10,1,10)
spawn.Position=Vector3.new(0,68,12)
spawn.Anchored=true
spawn.Neutral=true
spawn.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
spawn.Color=Color3.fromRGB(110,220,255)
spawn.Transparency=.15
spawn.Parent=main

part("Path",Vector3.new(12,1,34),Vector3.new(0,68,-12),Color3.fromRGB(154,121,82),Enum.Material.Ground,main)

for i,data in ipairs({
 {Vector3.new(70,78,-25),25},
 {Vector3.new(-75,88,-18),22},
 {Vector3.new(48,103,62),18},
 {Vector3.new(-52,112,58),20},
 {Vector3.new(0,132,-82),24}
}) do
 island("DistantIsland"..i,data[1],data[2])
end

for i=1,10 do
 local angle=(i/10)*math.pi*2
 local r=32+(i%3)*5
 local x=math.cos(angle)*r
 local z=math.sin(angle)*r
 local trunk=part("TreeTrunk"..i,Vector3.new(2.5,8,2.5),Vector3.new(x,72,z),Color3.fromRGB(105,72,45),Enum.Material.Wood,main)
 local leaves=part("TreeTop"..i,Vector3.new(9,9,9),Vector3.new(x,79,z),Color3.fromRGB(65,155,72),Enum.Material.Grass,main)
 leaves.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
end

local sign=part("WelcomeSign",Vector3.new(18,8,1),Vector3.new(0,73,-31),Color3.fromRGB(92,61,38),Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,main)
local gui=Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Front
gui.CanvasSize=Vector2.new(700,320)
gui.Parent=sign
local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
label.BackgroundTransparency=1
label.Text="SKYBOUND\nGRASSLANDS\nYour journey begins here"
label.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextScaled=true
label.TextWrapped=true
label.Parent=gui

local function setupPlayer(player)
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
 stats.Name="leaderstats"
 stats.Parent=player
 local coins=stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins") or Instance.new("IntValue")
 coins.Name="SkyCoins"
 coins.Value=0
 coins.Parent=stats
end

for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setupPlayer(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)

print("Skybound Build 1 loaded")

changes.name: SkyboundClient
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer

local old=player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("SkyboundUI")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name="SkyboundUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
gui.Parent=player.PlayerGui

local title=Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(330,65)
title.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-165,0,18)
title.BackgroundTransparency=1
title.Text="SKYBOUND"
title.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,70)
title.TextStrokeTransparency=.35
title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
title.TextScaled=true
title.Parent=gui

local coins=Instance.new("TextLabel")
coins.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(235,55)
coins.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,20)
coins.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(28,42,68)
coins.BackgroundTransparency=.12
coins.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
coins.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
coins.TextScaled=true
coins.Parent=gui
Instance.new("UICorner",coins).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,14)

local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Thickness=2
stroke.Transparency=.35
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(110,220,255)
stroke.Parent=coins

local stats=player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
local skyCoins=stats:WaitForChild("SkyCoins")
local function refresh()
 coins.Text="☁  SKY COINS   "..skyCoins.Value
end
skyCoins:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(refresh)
refresh()

local subtitle=Instance.new("TextLabel")
subtitle.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(420,38)
subtitle.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-210,1,-58)
subtitle.BackgroundTransparency=1
subtitle.Text="Explore • Collect • Ascend"
subtitle.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
subtitle.TextStrokeTransparency=.45
subtitle.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
subtitle.TextScaled=true
subtitle.Parent=gui
